"""Fixed all-case paired reductions, independent means and preserved controls."""
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from balanced_spatial_metrics import summarize
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');result=read(root/'scores-v1.json');old=read(plan['prior_scores']['path'])
assert result['component_forwards']==result['original_predictions_replayed_exact']==1644 and len(result['rows'])==6576
parents=[dict(r,method='parent') for r in old['rows'] if r['method']=='parent'];assert len(parents)==822
rows=result['rows']+parents;maps={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in rows};summary=summarize(rows)
groups=defaultdict(list)
for row in rows:groups[row['kind'],row.get('present',row.get('variant',row.get('noise'))),row.get('cohort'),row['method']].append(row)
maximum_difference=0.;checks=0
for g in summary:
    selected=groups[g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],g['method']]
    for field,value in g.items():
        if field in ['kind','condition','cohort','method','cases']:continue
        with localcontext() as context:
            context.prec=60
            expected=float(sum(Decimal.from_float(float(r[field])) for r in selected)/Decimal(len(selected)))
        difference=abs(value-expected);maximum_difference=max(maximum_difference,difference);assert difference<1e-10;checks+=1
paired=[]
for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
 for method in ['balanced','spectral-only','spatial-only']:
  label=f'{method}-{endpoint}'
  for baseline in [f'V168-{endpoint}','parent']:
   for key,selected in groups.items():
    kind,condition,cohort,current=key
    if current!=label or kind=='real':continue
    for field in selected[0]:
     if not field.endswith(('DN16','gain','error')):continue
     if not all(isinstance(r.get(field),(float,int)) and not isinstance(r.get(field),bool) and field in maps[r['id'],baseline] for r in selected):continue
     pairs=[dict(id=r['id'],candidate=r[field],baseline=maps[r['id'],baseline][field],difference=r[field]-maps[r['id'],baseline][field]) for r in selected]
     a=float(np.mean([p['candidate'] for p in pairs]));b=float(np.mean([p['baseline'] for p in pairs]));delta=[p['difference'] for p in pairs]
     paired.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=label,baseline=baseline,field=field,cases=len(pairs),
        mean_candidate=a,mean_baseline=b,percent_change=100*(a/b-1) if b else None,
        better=sum(d<0 for d in delta),worse=sum(d>0 for d in delta),equal=sum(d==0 for d in delta),
        maximum_increase=max(delta),maximum_decrease=min(delta),pairs=pairs))
save(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json',dict(status='completed-fixed-allcase-reductions',scores=ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),prior_scores=plan['prior_scores'],
    summary=summary,groups=paired,independent_Decimal_mean_checks=checks,maximum_Decimal_difference=maximum_difference,
    new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
for g in paired:
 if g['method'].startswith('balanced-') and g['baseline'].startswith('V168-') and g['field'] in ['template_gain','quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','quiet_DC_RMS_DN16','full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16']:
  print(g['method'],g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],g['field'],g['mean_candidate'],g['percent_change'],'better/worse',g['better'],g['worse'])
print('Independent Decimal mean checks',checks,'maxdiff',maximum_difference)

"""Audit saved native predictions, stream bindings, means and all inference inputs."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from balanced_spatial_metrics import DetailMetrics
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);result=read(root/'scores-v1.json');design=read(plan['design']['path'])
events=[__import__('json').loads(s) for s in (root/'forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
journal=[__import__('json').loads(s) for s in (root/'observations-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(events)==len(journal)==1644 and [v['returned_forwards'] for v in events]==list(range(1,1645))
assert all(o['original_replayed_exact'] for o in journal)
assert result['component_forwards']==result['original_predictions_replayed_exact']==1644 and result['RNG_unchanged'] and result['model_weights_unchanged']
old=read(plan['prior_scores']['path']);old_rows={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in old['rows']}
metric=DetailMetrics(plan['metrics_sources']);rows={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in result['rows']}
kernel=np.exp(-.5*(np.arange(-24,25,dtype=np.float64)/8)**2);kernel/=kernel.sum()
scalar_checks=inputs=predictions=component_arrays=original_replays=0;filter_pixels=0;maximum_value_difference=0.
for endpoint,binding in plan['collections'].items():
 collection=read(binding['path'])
 for index,(case,prior) in enumerate(zip(design['observations'],collection['observations'],strict=True)):
  event=events[(0 if endpoint=='raw' else 822)+index];record=journal[(0 if endpoint=='raw' else 822)+index]
  assert event['endpoint']==record['endpoint']==endpoint and event['id']==record['id']==case['id']
  assert event['index']==record['index']==index and record['arrays']==case['arrays'] and record['parent']==case['parent']
  assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
  assert record['original_prediction']==prior['prediction'] and ref(prior['prediction']['path'])==prior['prediction']
  a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));base=np.load(case['parent']['path']);original=np.load(prior['prediction']['path'])
  for field,f in prior['inputs'].items():assert fingerprint(a[field])==f;inputs+=1
  assert fingerprint(original)==rows[case['id'],f'V168-{endpoint}']['values'];original_replays+=1
  assert [r for r in result['rows'] if r['id']==case['id'] and r['endpoint']==endpoint]==record['rows']
  for row in record['rows']:
   if row['method'].startswith('V168-'):
    prior_row=old_rows[case['id'],f'fine-mesh-{endpoint}-step1000']
    for field,value in row.items():
     if field in prior_row and isinstance(value,(float,int)) and not isinstance(value,bool):assert abs(value-prior_row[field])<1e-10;scalar_checks+=1
  if case['id'] not in result['native_predictions']:continue
  bindings=result['native_predictions'][case['id']];values={}
  for method in ['V168','balanced','spectral-only','spatial-only']:
   name=f'{method}-{endpoint}';b=bindings[name];assert ref(b['path'])==b
   value=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(value)==rows[case['id'],name]['values'];values[method]=value
   actual=metric.measure(case,a,base,value)
   for field,v in actual.items():
    if isinstance(v,(float,int)) and not isinstance(v,bool):assert abs(v-rows[case['id'],name][field])<1e-10;scalar_checks+=1
   predictions+=1
  b=bindings[f'original-spatial-{endpoint}'];assert ref(b['path'])==b
  spatial=np.load(b['path']);assert fingerprint(spatial)==record['spatial_values'];component_arrays+=1
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(values['spatial-only'],base+spatial)
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(values['V168'],values['spectral-only']+spatial)
  lowpass=spatial.astype(np.float64)
  for axis in [-1,-2]:
   padding=[(0,0)]*4;padding[axis]=(24,24)
   lowpass=np.apply_along_axis(lambda v:np.convolve(v,kernel,mode='valid'),axis,np.pad(lowpass,padding,mode='edge'))
  expected=values['spectral-only']+(spatial.astype(np.float64)-lowpass).astype(np.float32)
  error=np.abs(expected.astype(np.float64)-values['balanced'].astype(np.float64))
  bound=2*np.spacing(np.maximum(np.abs(expected),np.abs(values['balanced'])))+2e-10
  assert np.all(error<=bound);filter_pixels+=error.size;maximum_value_difference=max(maximum_value_difference,float(error.max()))
assert inputs==6576 and original_replays==1644 and predictions==288 and component_arrays==72
assert result['exact_ADC_constant_outputs']==384
save(root/'independent-audit-v1.json',dict(status='pass-stream-bindings-native-predictions-and-inherited-metrics',plan=ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),scores=ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    actual_forward_events=1644,completed_observation_events=1644,original_replays_checked=original_replays,input_fingerprints_checked=inputs,
    scalar_checks=scalar_checks,saved_native_predictions_checked=predictions,saved_direct_corrections_checked=component_arrays,
    selected_filter_output_channels_recomputed=filter_pixels,maximum_selected_balanced_difference=maximum_value_difference,
    allcase_inprocess_filter_channels=result['independent_filter_pixels'],allcase_maximum_filter_error=result['maximum_filter_error'],
    forward_journal=ref(root/'forward-events-v1.jsonl'),observation_journal=ref(root/'observations-v1.jsonl'),
    new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    scope='All1644 actual event/input/original-prediction bindings checked. All6576 metric rows match durable journals;original1644 metric rows match the inherited scores. Independent saved-array metric/filter recomputation covers36 selected cases at both endpoints,288 original/new predictions plus72 direct corrections. Remaining new predictions were scored/fingerprinted and independently Gaussian/norm-checked in process,not retained for separate posthoc recomputation. No full new prediction archive or full new-array posthoc audit is claimed.'))
print('PASS1644 actual replay/input journals;288 native original/new predictions,72 corrections;',scalar_checks,'scalars')

"""Append an original-detail viewing only after the assistant saw the pixels."""
import argparse,json,time
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3')
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('sheets');parser.add_argument('notes');args=parser.parse_args()
selected=[int(n) for n in args.sheets.split(',')];figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json');journal=root/'native-viewing-v1.jsonl'
events=[json.loads(s) for s in journal.read_text().splitlines()] if journal.exists() else []
seen={n for e in events for n in e['sheets']};assert not seen.intersection(selected) and len(set(selected))==len(selected)
assert all(0<=n<18 for n in selected)
for n in selected:assert ref(figures['sheets'][n]['image']['path'])==figures['sheets'][n]['image']
event=dict(recorded_unix_UTC=time.time(),sheets=selected,detail='original',notes=args.notes)
with journal.open('a') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(event)+'\n')
events.append(event);seen.update(selected)
if len(seen)==18:
 assert seen==set(range(18))
 indices=[i for n in sorted(seen) for i in figures['sheets'][n]['indices']];assert sorted(indices)==list(range(72))
 save(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json',dict(status='actually-viewed72-native-figures-in18-original-detail-sheets',
    figures=ref(root/'figures-v1.json'),journal=ref(journal),events=events,indices=sorted(indices),native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,no_resize=True))
print('Recorded',selected,';viewed',len(seen))
